name: Open Graph Preview
summary: Preview how your Open Graph tags will look on Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and Discord.
description: Fill in og:title, description, image, and URL fields — or paste existing meta tags — then see approximate social share cards for major platforms. Client-side only; no live URL fetching.

faqs.question: Does this fetch my live page?
faqs.answer: No. Previews are built from the fields you enter or meta tags you paste — nothing is scraped from the web.

faqs.question: How accurate is it?
faqs.answer: Layouts approximate common platforms; actual rendering may vary slightly by app and theme.
